items.title: JEPI Vs. GPIQ: The 5% Treasury Test For Retirees
items.zh_title: JEPI 与 GPIQ：面对约 5% 国债收益率的收益权衡
items.summary: The author's public summary compares JEPI with GPIQ and a Treasury yield around five percent. It says GPIQ had a higher trailing distribution and greater technology concentration, while JEPI had a steadier profile and a narrower income advantage over Treasuries.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要比较 JEPI、GPIQ 与约 5% 的国债收益率：GPIQ 的历史分配率和科技股集中度较高；JEPI 波动较低，但相对国债的收益优势收窄。这是作者观点，分配率不是保证收益。
items.verify_next: 核验同日分配率、税后总回报、期权覆盖规则和科技股集中度。

items.source: Yahoo Finance ETF Headlines / 24/7 Wall St.
items.title: VGT Holders Bought ‘Tech’ and Own No Google, Meta, or Amazon: The Sector Rule That Decides What’s Inside
items.zh_title: VGT 的科技行业口径为何不包含 Alphabet、Meta 和 Amazon
items.summary: The article explains that VGT tracks a GICS Information Technology benchmark. Alphabet and Meta belong to Communication Services and Amazon belongs to Consumer Discretionary, so an investor adding VGT to an S&P 500 fund increases exposure to other large technology holdings rather than to those three companies.
items.zh_summary: 原文指出，VGT 跟踪 GICS 信息技术口径：Alphabet、Meta 被归入通信服务，Amazon 属于可选消费，因此不在 VGT 内。与宽基 ETF 叠加时，应核对实际持股重合与行业集中。
items.verify_next: 以基金及指数提供商当期持仓、分类和权重文件复核，不把文章中的持仓权重当作永久值。

items.title: MOO: Tailwinds Are Priced In, AI Is A Threat And Boon (Downgrade)
items.zh_title: MOO 农业企业 ETF：利好是否已反映在价格中
items.summary: The author's public summary says MOO gained about twenty percent since the previous review and downgrades the fund to Hold. It cites potentially priced-in policy and geopolitical tailwinds, rising input costs, and AI as both a threat and an opportunity for agribusiness.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要称，MOO 自其上次评论后上涨约 20%，并将个人评级下调至 Hold；理由包括利好可能已反映、投入成本压力，以及 AI 对农业企业兼有利弊。并非独立验证的未来收益预测。
items.verify_next: 核验该期间实际总回报、成分企业盈利与估值、农业投入成本和 AI 应用证据。

items.title: FLRN: Zero Duration Bond ETF To Protect Against Rate Hikes
items.zh_title: FLRN 浮息债 ETF：低久期与信用风险要分开看
items.summary: The author's public summary describes FLRN as an investment-grade floating-rate bond fund with near-zero interest-rate duration. It also notes significant financial-sector exposure and a risk-and-return profile close to FLOT, while arguing that rising rates could support the floating coupons.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要称，FLRN 持有投资级浮息票据，利率久期接近零，利率上升时票息可调整；同时存在金融业集中和信用风险，不能把低久期理解成无风险。
items.verify_next: 核验基金事实表中的久期、信用评级、金融业权重、息差及与 FLOT 的同口径成本。

items.title: 4 High-Yield ETFs Offering Hedges Against Rising Inflation And Higher Interest Rates
items.zh_title: 四只高收益 ETF 的利率与通胀对冲主张
items.summary: The author's public summary names PFIX, RISR, SRLN, and CLOZ as funds with different responses to higher rates and inflation. It presents PFIX as a volatile tactical rate hedge and the other funds as income-oriented exposures, without establishing that their distributions or hedges are guaranteed.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要列出 PFIX、RISR、SRLN、CLOZ，认为其在高利率和通胀环境中具有不同用途；其中 PFIX 被描述为波动较高的战术利率对冲，其他产品偏向收益敞口。四者风险结构不同，不能仅凭分配率并列比较。
items.verify_next: 分别核验利率敏感度、信用和 CLO 风险、分配来源、杠杆与费用，再比较压力情景总回报。

items.title: ROE: High-Quality Portfolio Positioned To Outperform IVV, Buy Rating Maintained
items.zh_title: ROE 等权质量 ETF：作者维持优于 IVV 的观点
items.summary: The author's public summary describes ROE as an actively managed, technology-heavy equal-weight quality fund. It says four holdings changed, claims a year-to-date lead over IVV, and warns that a relatively high downside capture ratio could hurt in a bearish market.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要称，ROE 是偏科技的主动管理等权质量基金，近期更换四只持股；作者预计它可能继续优于 IVV，同时承认较高的下行捕获率可能使其在熊市落后。预测与评级只代表作者观点。
items.verify_next: 核验持仓日期、质量因子定义、费用、与 IVV 的同区间总回报及下行捕获率。

items.title: Estimating the risk of recession in the US
items.zh_title: FRED 美国衰退概率模型及其误报
items.summary: The FRED Blog says the August 2026 monthly recession probability was 0.08%, using manufacturing PMI and ECB CISS; prior spikes in October 1998 and March 2023 were false positives.
items.zh_summary: FRED Blog 介绍以制造业 PMI 与欧洲央行 CISS 衡量的美国月度衰退概率，2026 年 8 月为 0.08%；它也提醒 1998 年 10 月及 2023 年 3 月曾出现未演变为衰退的尖峰。
items.verify_next: 核验历史发布时点、样本外校准、修订和对跨资产组合的增量预测能力。

items.title: HYS: High-Risk Credit Remains Unsupportive
items.zh_title: HYS 短久期高收益债的信用利差风险
items.summary: The public author summary says HYS has an approximately 6.75% 30-day SEC yield and 0.56% expenses, but claims its roughly 2.75% credit spread is near 20-year lows; the author sees unfavorable compensation for credit risk.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要称 HYS 的 30 日 SEC 收益率约 6.75%、费率约 0.56%，但认为约 2.75% 的信用利差接近 20 年低位，短久期并不能消除违约风险。数值与判断均待同日基金及指数资料复核。
items.verify_next: 核验同日 SEC 收益率、有效久期、OAS、评级结构、费用和压力期损失。

items.title: PFM: Unappealing Dividend Growth ETF, Likely To Trail IVV, A Hold
items.zh_title: PFM 股息增长 ETF 与 IVV 的质量和估值比较
items.summary: The author public summary maintains Hold on PFM and expects underperformance versus IVV into 2027, citing a value tilt but weaker quality and GARP characteristics; the author explicitly does not claim a bearish thesis.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要维持 PFM 的 Hold 评级，称其虽偏价值，但质量和合理价格成长特征弱于 IVV，并预测至 2027 年表现可能落后；作者明确未提出看空论证。
items.verify_next: 复核两基金当期持仓、因子定义、费用、税后总回报及样本外表现。

items.title: Four Reasons Why FLCH Is Back To Being A 'BUY Rating' For Me
items.zh_title: FLCH 中国股票 ETF 的估值与事件假设
items.summary: The author public summary upgrades FLCH and estimates a 10.8-11.2x forward P/E, about 7% below its ten-year average, with a diplomatic catalyst and asymmetric one-year return scenario; these are author calculations and forecasts.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要将 FLCH 上调至 Buy，估算远期市盈率 10.8–11.2 倍、较十年均值低约 7%，并提出外交事件催化和一年情景收益；均为作者估算与预测。
items.verify_next: 核验估值口径、指数成分、汇率风险、事件日期和情景概率，不把评级当信号。

items.source: Yahoo Finance ETF Headlines / 24/7 Wall St.
items.title: SPY’s 9.45 Basis Points Hides $6,450 a Decade on $100,000 Versus Cheaper Peers
items.zh_title: SPY 与 VOO、IVV 的费用及结构比较
items.summary: The article compares SPY 0.0945% expenses with VOO/IVV 0.03%, and discusses SPY unit-investment-trust dividend cash drag and securities lending; its $6,450-per-decade headline is not supported by the simple 6.45-basis-point annual fee difference on $100,000.
items.zh_summary: 原文比较 SPY 0.0945% 与 VOO/IVV 0.03% 的费率，并讨论 UIT 结构的分红现金拖累。标题所称 10 年 6,450 美元差额不能由 10 万美元每年 6.45 基点费差直接推出，需另验。
items.verify_next: 核验当期招募说明书、跟踪差、税后总回报、交易价差及标题计算假设。

items.source: Yahoo Finance ETF Headlines / 24/7 Wall St.
items.title: The Case For and Against Fidelity’s Fundamental Large Cap Growth ETF
items.zh_title: FFLG 主动成长 ETF 的 AI 持仓集中风险
items.summary: The publisher article compares FFLG with VUG and QQQ and reports NVIDIA at 16.24% and Alphabet share classes at 13.59% combined. It says recent one-year performance beat VUG while the five-year result lagged.
items.zh_summary: 原文称 FFLG 近一年胜过 VUG、五年落后；NVIDIA 占 16.24%，Alphabet 两类股份合计约 13.59%。其成败高度取决于 AI 资本开支与主动持仓调整，文中收益和权重均需按当期文件核对。
items.verify_next: 核验同日持仓、费用、基金与基准同口径总回报及云厂商资本开支。

items.title: Most Stocks Are Losers
items.zh_title: 宽基上涨时多数个股仍可能跑输
items.summary: Ben Carlson says only 35% of S&P 500 stocks beat the index year to date and cites a separate report claiming 23% beat it over the last decade; he argues winner concentration challenges stock selection.
items.zh_summary: Ben Carlson 称截至周四标普 500 年内涨逾 13%，但仅 35% 成分股跑赢指数、四成下跌；他引述另一研究称过去十年仅 23% 跑赢。说明市值加权指数的少数赢家集中效应，原始统计口径待复核。
items.verify_next: 重建逐期成分股和退市股，核验价格与总回报口径、等权对照及不同市场阶段。

items.title: VBR: Small-Cap Value Feeling The Brunt Of Soaring Treasury Rates
items.zh_title: VBR 小盘价值股的利率与区域银行敞口
items.summary: The public author summary rates VBR Buy, cites 13.6x P/E and 1.28x PEG, and says rising Treasury yields and regional bank exposure weigh on small-cap value.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要称 VBR 估值约 13.6 倍市盈率、PEG 约 1.28，认为国债收益率上升与区域银行敞口构成压力，但维持个人 Buy 评级。估值与评级均属作者口径。
items.verify_next: 核验持仓、估值日期、区域银行权重、利率敏感度与同区间基准总回报。

items.title: EWP: Spanish Equities Appear To Be Fairly Valued
items.zh_title: EWP 西班牙股票 ETF 的估值与行业集中
items.summary: The public author summary cites about 16x P/E and 2.7% yield for EWP and says Santander, BBVA and Iberdrola approach half of assets, limiting diversification.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要称 EWP 约 16 倍市盈率、股息率 2.7%，桑坦德、BBVA 与 Iberdrola 合计接近资产一半；行业和欧元汇率集中使其并非广泛欧洲分散配置。
items.verify_next: 核验基金当期持仓、估值与股息口径、欧元汇率暴露及对宽基欧洲 ETF 的增量分散。

items.title: IEZ: Strong 2026 Gains Meet A Constrained CapEx Outlook
items.zh_title: IEZ 油服 ETF 的涨幅与资本开支约束
items.summary: The public author summary attributes IEZ strength to geopolitical oil-price shocks while arguing its oil-service holdings face slower customer capital spending and stretched valuation.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要认为 IEZ 年内强势部分来自地缘供给冲击；SLB、Baker Hughes 和 TechnipFMC 等油服企业仍受客户资本开支放缓影响，并担忧估值偏高。这是作者判断。
items.verify_next: 核验持仓、油企资本开支指引、估值基准、油价与油服收益的历史敏感度。

items.title: TNGY: Energy ETF Positioned To Profit From Market Realities
items.zh_title: TNGY 主动能源 ETF 的炼油与 LNG 集中敞口
items.summary: The public author summary says TNGY allocates across natural gas, NGLs, refining and LNG export infrastructure, with top holdings over half of assets and a stated 0.85% expense ratio.
items.zh_summary: 作者公开摘要称 TNGY 主动配置天然气、NGL、炼油与 LNG 出口基础设施，主要持仓合计过半，费率 0.85%；所称年内总回报 24% 与能源前景是作者陈述。
items.verify_next: 核验基金持仓、费率与年内总回报，分解油气价格、裂解价差和 LNG 项目风险。
